method: Scan: every declaration `<type> <name>[<SIZE>]` in tensor_cuda/src/*.cu, *.cuh, *.cpp (recursive), tensor_cuda/include,
tc_signal/src, tc_signal/include. Arrays sized TC_MAX_DIMS are indexed by axis (rank-bound); every other size is
listed with its reason for being rank-independent. Consumers of each TC_MAX_DIMS spec: every function that declares

rank_independent_arrays.name: small
rank_independent_arrays.text: template <typename T, int FORWARD>  // FORWARD: big[bigoff]=small[i]; else small[i]=big[bigoff]

rank_independent_arrays.text: const float camera[4], const float* __restrict__ matrix,

rank_independent_arrays.name: origin
rank_independent_arrays.text: const float origin[3], const float direction[3], float distance,

rank_independent_arrays.name: origin
rank_independent_arrays.text: const float origin[3], const float direction[3], float hit_distance,

rank_independent_arrays.name: normal

rank_independent_arrays.name: position

rank_independent_arrays.name: position
rank_independent_arrays.text: const float position[3], float depth, float vertical_projection_pixels,

rank_independent_arrays.name: direction
rank_independent_arrays.text: const float direction[3], int max_steps, float distance_limit,

rank_independent_arrays.name: ctab
rank_independent_arrays.text: __shared__ unsigned ctab[256];   // byte (two nibbles, even dim low) -> bf16x2 of the two centroids (hi part)

rank_independent_arrays.name: own
rank_independent_arrays.text: long long own[kKinds] = {0, 0};  // this thread's own (excluded)

rank_independent_reason: sized by a geometry constant (3 = xyz in terrain / dda / paint), a fixed operand count (gated_delta_step's 8 inputs; kl/ql/sl[8] = Dk/32 rows per lane, Dk <= 256 checked at its entry), a cuBLASLt heuristic request count (heur[8]), an accumulator width (ACCN, kDetailOctaves, Channels) or the shared-memory reduction width: none is indexed by an operand's rank
